# أَتَفَلْوَرُ (ʔatafalwaru) /ʔa.ta.fal.wa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
# أَتَفَلْوَرَ (ʔatafalwara) /ʔa.ta.fal.wa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
# أَتَفَلْوَرْ (ʔatafalwar) /ʔa.ta.fal.war/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
